dailyManna.text: The harvest truly is plenteous, but the labourers are few; Pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he will send forth labourers into his harvest.

training.title: Acts of Missions and Soul Winning
training.subtitle: Responsibility of Every Believer
training.dates: Dates to be announced. Contact the ministry to express interest and ask about future training announcements.

prayerBurdens.title: Unreached Tribes & Hostile Territories
prayerBurdens.description: Praying for divine protection, open doors, and receptive hearts in regions where the gospel has never been preached or faces severe persecution.

prayerBurdens.title: Sustenance & Health for Laborers
prayerBurdens.description: Interceding for field missionaries and their families facing hunger, sickness, and financial distress. That God supplies every need.

prayerBurdens.title: Awakening the Burden for Souls
prayerBurdens.description: Breaking lukewarmness and religious complacency. Praying for young believers to catch the fire of evangelism and personal discipleship.

prayerBurdens.title: Backsliders & Bound Souls to be Rescued
prayerBurdens.description: Fervent prayer pulling souls out of demonic bondage, moral collapse, and spiritual blindness into the marvelous light of Christ.
